scope: Generic OBD-II standardized code reference. These are not a substitute for HD-OBD OEM code translation or a vehicle-specific diagnostic procedure.

source.title: SAE J2012 APR2002 — Diagnostic Trouble Code Definitions
source.review_note: Publicly accessible historical edition incorporated by reference in 40 CFR 86.1806-04. SAE J2012 has since been revised; confirm current assignment and exact wording against the current applicable edition before relying on it. IronKnuckle descriptions are original paraphrases.
